svg.title: Evora: four sub-dials, one question
svg.desc: Plate one, Evora: four camera sub-dials, each with a sweeping scan hand. On camera 1, main gate, the hand finds a red car and holds while a lume ring blooms; a dotted trace follows one person from camera 2 to camera 4; the answer reads found, camera 1, 14:32:07, clip 0:06. Measured on one MEVA site: Hit@5 0.72 dev, 0.69 test; negative precision 1.00 on dev against 0.00 for a frame-similarity baseline. Runs on one laptop with an 8 GB GPU, faces blurred. Live, source public, hackathon team build.
